title: User-supplied AtomicGlobe / MeridianGlobe local integration

license.component: No explicit component license declaration was present in the supplied module or its wrapper. Source is preserved with original comments and URLs; this record does not assert a new license.
license.coastline: Supplied source identifies its baked occupancy grid as derived from Natural Earth 110m land, public domain.

removed_host_dependencies: React marker/card UI (no places are configured)
preserved_algorithms: coast occupancy RLE and signed proximity field
source Three geometry, projection, formation and rotation math
adaptations: Reproduce from the dashboard directory: node vendor/atomic-globe/adapt.mjs
Externally owned visibility/reduced-motion lifecycle and 30fps frame driver, virtual time excluding hidden/paused duration
Maximum pixel ratio 1.5, low-power renderer, maximum canvas layout size 512x512
Idempotent cleanup including partial initialization and WebGL context loss
Nemo theme: transparent surroundings, white dots, cyan accent, 8000 target dots (7996 actual), no places/routes/cursor capture
Static 189px PNG projected from the exact supplied dot lattice for reduced-motion/no-WebGL fallback
scientific_scope: Decorative landing globe only. No trial, observation, source, model, provider, device or messaging state is used or changed.
